hypothesis: Interpret each consecutive pair of bytes in the signed WN-14 groups A-D as (printed page, one-based main-body word) in Frank Cowper, Sailing Tours, Part II (1893).
coordinate_convention: Read bytes left-to-right within groups A, B, C, D; each adjacent pair is (printed page number, one-based main-body word index).
counting_convention: Use the existing Cowper Part II OCR convention: grayscale page; exclude the top 150 and bottom 60 pixels (running head and folio); autocontrast; Tesseract English PSM 6; join line-end hyphenation; count visual-order main-body tokens matching the existing WORD_PATTERN; include body headings, captions, tables and footnotes. Select one-based word positions before K08 normalization.
limitations: Cowper Part II is a conditional book candidate, not an authenticated identification of David's physical map-back book.
The WN-14 byte-pair page/word interpretation is a hypothesis; the signed source itself does not label these bytes as coordinates.
Only this one page/word order, edition, volume and counting convention are tested.
